topic: Surah Al-Hujurat 49:12: suspicion, spying and backbiting
coreInsight: Qur'an 49:12 asks us to avoid much assumption, not to spy and not to backbite, and 49:13 reminds us that the most noble are the most righteous.

script.onScreen: How do you think about others? / One ayah. One lesson.

REFLECTION / The lesson / The ayah starts in the mind: assumptions come before spying and backbiting. Guard the thought, and the words follow. Honour is measured by righteousness, not by what we say about others.
LIVE IT TODAY / Give one person an excuse you'd want for yourself · Don't search for what others hide · Stop a conversation that turns to someone absent
Think well of others. / Save this reminder

📖 Sources
• Qur'an 49:12 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/49/12
Full text: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful
• Qur'an 49:13 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/49/13
Full text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted
